title: fix: install Ask Jev shared dependencies
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Installs the locked root dependencies used by the shared decision schema.
- Fixes the isolated production deploy failure where `zod` could not resolve.
- Keeps the existing shared schema as the single source of truth.

Tested: standalone app install, 9 app tests, Wrangler dry-run.

gist.headline: Ask Jev Finds Zod
gist.blurb: Ask Jev’s deploy now brings along the shared schema ingredients it already relies on. The hive packed the missing jar, and production can make decisions again.
gist.summary: Updated apps/ask-jev-mcp/deploy.json to install the locked root dependencies used by the shared decision schema, resolving the isolated production deploy failure where zod could not be found.
gist.impact: Ask Jev MCP deployments can now use the existing shared decision schema successfully, with zod available in the standalone production environment.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful deployment gardener carrying a labeled dependency crate to a cozy retro terminal running Ask Jev’s decision schema. A small code-plant shaped like a branching decision tree grows healthily once the missing zod package is placed in the shared supply shelf; include the eager CRT monitor robot inspecting the successful deploy.
